training.readout: last recurrent sequence output, inherited unchanged
training.input_scaler: RobustScaler fitted only unique training-window rows
training.target_scaler: MinMaxScaler fitted only training target rows

main_selection: Lowest mean validation price RMSE over all five seeds. First choose C half-life using validation, then compare A/B/selected C. Exact ties prefer fewer features, then half-life order 3,6,12. Keep all five seeds, no best-test seed.
fold_policy: Each earlier rolling fold independently trains and selects from its own earlier train/validation data. Never apply main-period selected weights or hyperparameters backward. These assess the selection procedure, not five-seed performance of one main-selected configuration at an earlier date.
baseline: Reuse five original main BiLSTM-BTC runs, and seed42 per earlier fold. Four missing technical seeds per rolling fold are optional expansion for complete five-seed rolling comparison, trained in NEW subproject only with unchanged baseline code/config/data. Original experiments never altered.
evaluation: For each fold, write a hashed selection lock before loading evaluation labels or calling evaluation inference. Evaluate only the selected news configuration, all five seeds, once. Report technical/persistence same targets; existing ARIMAX contextual. Do not evaluate losing candidates.
main_primary_claim: Primary matched comparison is main five-seed result. Full earlier five-seed rolling extension is planned sequentially subject to compute; incomplete work must be labelled.

major_news_definition.rule: Retained focused article: leadership_policy or macro_risk topic OR allowed event with reg_access_flag or surprise_flag=1; any such article in trailing24 completed hourly buckets.
major_news_definition.ordinary: No matching article; includes quiet periods and other focused news.
major_news_definition.purpose: Predefined reporting subgroup only; no outcome-selected turning points.

availability: Publication-time retrospective proxy; source and original-version availability unverified. Full historical leakage-free claim is not supported.
failure_rule: Do not force improvement. If validation winner is worse than technical, report it and still evaluate this preselected hybrid once as an ablation, not as a recommended upgrade. No post-test replacement.
training_authorization: User requested report, preparation and start training after describing enhancements.

news_filter.promotion_regex: best (?:crypto|coins?|tokens?)|next (?:100x|1000x)|\bpresale\b|\bprice prediction|\bprice forecast|\bprice target|expert predicts|could (?:hit|reach)|will .*reach \$|set to explode
news_filter.limitations: Deterministic lexical screen, not verified factuality; multilingual titles rely partly on cached categories. Reaction reports retained at real publication time; no backdating or score correction.

annotation_additions: Original four plus ten new hourly assistant-scored source summaries; two date-only scores remain metadata; six unverified leads unscored; one existing source not duplicated
annotation_caveat: Mixed annotator provenance; not blinded to prior conversation. Retrospective targeted coverage repair. Surprise is a textual flag, not measured market surprise.
metadata_exclusion: Use only technical_feature_order plus candidate allowlist. All JSON fields, source counters, split roles, target fields and timestamps excluded.
